description: Register a webhook URL to receive real-time notifications for specific ChatPush events (e.g. whatsapp_log_out, delivery status updates, incoming messages). Use it when the user wants their server, CRM or automation (n8n, Make, Zapier) to receive replies or react to WhatsApp/Telegram events.

types.description: Event types: whatsapp_log_out (WhatsApp account disconnected); whatsapp_log_in (WhatsApp account connected); whatsapp_incoming_msg (incoming and outgoing WhatsApp messages (with file download links) and incoming WhatsApp calls); tdlib_incoming_msg (incoming and outgoing personal Telegram messages (with file download links) and Telegram calls); max_incoming_msg (incoming and outgoing messages of a connected MAX account); whatsapp_status_msg (statuses of outgoing WhatsApp messages: sent, received, read, played, failed, expired, …).

url.description: HTTPS URL to receive notifications as POST requests.

name: create_webhook
title: Create webhook
